# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Platform and runtime refinements**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves platform support, native packaging, rendering synchronization, and managed memory efficiency. Apple deployment targets have moved forward, WebGPU support is bundled more reliably, and several managed and HarfBuzz paths now reduce unnecessary allocations or retained data.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Platform

- **Apple deployment minimums raised** — Updates the minimum supported Apple platform versions for the current runtime and tooling baseline. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))
- **WebGPU native support packaged with SkiaSharp** — Includes emdawnwebgpu's webgpu.cpp in libSkiaSharp.a so consumers using the WebGPU backend receive the required native implementation. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
- **Android texture rendering synchronized to display refresh** — Coordinates texture rendering with the display refresh cycle for smoother Android presentation. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Bundled HarfBuzz functions bound locally on Linux** — Resolves HarfBuzz entry points from the bundled library on Linux, keeping text-shaping support self-contained. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Managed pixel copies made more efficient** — Optimizes managed image pixel-copy paths to reduce overhead when transferring pixel data. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052))
- **HarfBuzz text processing allocations reduced** — Reuses UTF-32 encoding buffers and avoids unnecessary native feature-string allocation while preserving shaping and decoding behavior. ([#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))
- **Front-buffered streams release retained data** — Corrects front-buffered stream retention so data is not kept longer than necessary. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
